cards.ex: Ever since I saw that travel documentary, I've had the wanderlust bug.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha sayohat haqidagi hujjatli filmni ko'rganimdan beri, menda sayohat ishtiyoqi paydo bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga bo'lgan kuchli va doimiy ishtiyoq yoki xohish.

cards.ex: We did a whistle-stop tour of Europe last summer.
cards.exUz: Biz o'tgan yozda Yevropaga tezkor sayohat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda qisqa va tez sayohat, ko'p joylarga qisqa vaqt ichida tashrif buyurish.

cards.ex: We're planning to rough it on our camping trip.
cards.exUz: Biz lager sayohatimizda qulayliklarsiz qilishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Qulayliklarsiz sayohat qilish, masalan, chodirda uxlash yoki oddiy ovqatlar bilan kifoyalanish.

cards.ex: As a flight attendant, she basically lives out of a suitcase.
cards.exUz: Uchuvchi sifatida, u asosan chamadonda yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida sayohatda bo'lish, uyda emas, balki mehmonxonalarda yashash.

cards.ex: The hotel is booked solid for the conference.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona konferentsiya uchun to'liq band qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Joylarning to'liq band qilinganligi, hech qanday bo'sh joy yo'qligi.

cards.ex: That souvenir shop is a total touristy trap.
cards.exUz: Bu sovg'alar do'koni to'liq sayyohlar tuzog'i.
cards.uzDef: Sayyohlarni jalb qilish uchun mo'ljallangan, qimmat va unchalik qiziqarli bo'lmagan joy.

cards.ex: They decided to get off the grid and live in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Ular aloqadan uzilishga va tog'larda yashashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy texnologiyalardan voz kechib, odamlardan uzoqda yashash.

cards.ex: The shoulder season is the best time to visit, less crowded.
cards.exUz: Mavsumlar oralig'i tashrif buyurish uchun eng yaxshi vaqt, odamlar kamroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori va eng past sayyohlik mavsumlari o'rtasidagi davr.

cards.ex: I need a vacation to recharge my batteries.
cards.exUz: Menga kuch yig'ish uchun ta'til kerak.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish orqali energiyani tiklash, yangi kuch bilan qaytish.

cards.ex: They decided to travel on a whim and booked a last-minute flight.
cards.exUz: Ular to'satdan sayohat qilishga qaror qilishdi va so'nggi daqiqalarda reysga joy buyurtma qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, birdaniga sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: This coffee shop is a popular local hangout.
cards.exUz: Bu qahvaxona mashhur mahalliy maskan.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy aholi ko'p vaqtini o'tkazadigan joy, masalan, kafe yoki bar.

cards.ex: After seeing her photos, I got the travel bug.
cards.exUz: Uning rasmlarini ko'rgandan so'ng, menda sayohatga qiziqish uyg'ondi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga bo'lgan qiziqishning birdaniga paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I just decided to hop on a plane and visit my sister.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki samolyotga o'tirishga va singlimni ziyorat qilishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Samolyotga tezda o'tirish va sayohatga otlanish.

cards.ex: They're dreaming of a far-flung destination for their honeymoon.
cards.exUz: Ular asal oyi uchun uzoqdagi joy haqida orzu qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq va qiyin yetib boriladigan sayohat joyi.

cards.ex: I had to take a red-eye to get to the meeting on time.
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishga vaqtida yetib borish uchun tungi reysda uchishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kechasi uchadigan va erta tongda yetib boradigan samolyot reysi.

cards.ex: We just want a fly-and-flop holiday on a tropical island.
cards.exUz: Biz shunchaki tropik orolda dam olishni xohlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish va hech narsa qilmaslik uchun mo'ljallangan sayohat.

cards.ex: I want to travel, but I don't want to break the bank.
cards.exUz: Men sayohat qilishni xohlayman, lekin xarajatdan o'tishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p pul sarflash, moliyaviy jihatdan juda qimmatga tushish.

cards.ex: We found a lovely restaurant off the beaten track.
cards.exUz: Biz mashhur bo'lmagan joyda ajoyib restoran topdik.
cards.uzDef: Odatda sayyohlar tashrif buyurmaydigan, yashirin joy.

cards.ex: We had to make changes on the fly due to the weather.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo tufayli biz tezda o'zgarishlar qilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda, oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, harakat davomida bajarish.

cards.ex: I always try to get a window seat on the plane.
cards.exUz: Men doim samolyotda deraza yonidagi joyni olishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Samolyot yoki poyezdda deraza yonidagi joy.

cards.ex: This small village is a hidden gem.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik qishloq yashirin gavhar.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik bilmaydigan, lekin juda qimmatli va qiziqarli joy.

cards.ex: The market really gives you a taste of the local flavour.
cards.exUz: Bozor sizga mahalliy muhitdan haqiqiy taassurot qoldiradi.
cards.uzDef: Joyning o'ziga xos madaniyati, an'analari va atmosferasi.

cards.ex: They always travel in style, staying in luxury hotels.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim hashamatli sayohat qilishadi, hashamatli mehmonxonalarda qolishadi.
cards.uzDef: Qulaylik va hashamat bilan sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: The village is postcard-perfect, with its charming houses.
cards.exUz: Qishloq o'zining jozibali uylari bilan ochiqcha rasmdek.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va suratga olishga arziydigan manzarali joy.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get my bearings in the city.
cards.exUz: Menga shaharda yo'nalishni aniqlash uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi joyda o'z yo'nalishingizni aniqlash, atrofni tushunish.

cards.ex: Can you put me up for the night?
cards.exUz: Meni bir kechaga tunab qoldira olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Bir kechani o'tkazish uchun joy topish, tunab qolish.

cards.ex: This guesthouse is a home away from home.
cards.exUz: Bu mehmonxona uydan uzoqdagi uydek.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni qulay va erkin his qiladigan joy, o'z uyingizdek.

cards.ex: We traveled Europe on a shoestring budget.
cards.exUz: Biz Yevropani arzon narxda sayohat qildik.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan sayohat qilish, tejamkorlik bilan.

cards.ex: They finally took the plunge and booked their dream vacation.
cards.exUz: Ular nihoyat tavakkal qilishdi va orzularidagi ta'tilga joy buyurtma qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish, tavakkal qilib ishga kirishish.

cards.ex: We arrived and had to hit the ground running to prepare for the conference.
cards.exUz: Biz yetib keldik va konferentsiyaga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun tez boshlashimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va samarali boshlash, vaqtni behuda sarflamaslik.
